div.l: This Reve sat vp on̄ a well gode stotte
That was pomely grey and hight scotte
A longe surcote of pers he had
And by his syde he bare a rousty blade
Of Norfolk was this Reve of which ytell
By syde a toune men̄ clepe baldeswell
Tukked he was as ys a Frere aboute
And eủer he Rode þe hyndrest of our rowte
¶ A Sompnour͗ with us also þ̉er was
That had a fyry cherubynz fase
For sauseflem̄ he was with yȝen̄ narowe
As hote ⁊and lecherous as ys a sparowe
With scabbed browes blak and pylled berd
Of his vysage chylder were ofte aferde
There nas quyk syluer lytarge ne brymston̄
Boras Orsure ne oyle of tart̉er none
Ne oynement þat wold clense ⁊and byte
That hym myght helpe of his whelkꝭes white
Nor of the knobbz syttyng of his chekes
Well loued he garlyk oynoıı̄uns ⁊and lekꝭes
And for to drynke stronge wyne rede as blod
Then̄ wold he speke and crye as he were wode
And when̄ that he well dronken̄ had þe wyne
Then̄ wolt he speke no word but latyn̄
A Fewe termes had he two or thre
That he had lerned oute of som̄ degre
No wonder as he herde hit all þe day
And eke ye knowe well how þᵗat a iay
Kan̄ clepe watte as wel as þe pope
But ho so cowthe hym in oþ̉er thyngꝭes grope
Then̄ had he spende alle his philosophie
